units: Sifré Deut. 306 (ref. to יערף, Deut. XXXII, 2) אין יַעֲרֹף … פרוט … אלא עֲרוֹף לי וכ׳ yaʿʿărof is a Phoenician (mercantile) term, e.g. one does not say to one’s neighbor, pʾroṭ (break into small change) this Selʿa for me, but ʿărof for me &c.—Denom. עוֹרֶף.—2) (cmp. קָטַף a. קְטָף) to drop, distill.

<cite ref="Taanit 7a:4">Taan. 7ᵃ</cite> (ref. to Deut. l. c.) <he>אם ת״ח … ואם לאו עוֹרְפֵיהוּ כמטר</he> if a scholar is worthy, he is like dew; if unworthy, drop him like rain; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 942:30">Yalk. Deut. 942</cite> <he>עָרְפֵהוּ</he>.

senses.gloss: (denom. of עוֹרֶף) to break the neck of; esp. to break the neck of a heifer to atone for a murder the author of which is unknown (Deut. XXI, 1–9); to perform the ceremony of atonement.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:2">Sot. IX, 2</cite> <he>לא היו עוֹרְפִין</he> they did not perform the ceremony.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:5">Ib. IX, 5</cite> <he>ועורפין אותה בקופיץ וכ׳</he> and (if the ground is not hard and rough) they cut her head from behind with a hatchet.—Part. pass. <he>עָרוּף</he>; f. <he>עֲרוּפָה</he>.—<he>עגלה ע׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00097"><he>עֶגְלָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (cmp. אָחַר) (of copulations of animals) to cover (from behind). Ib. 42ᵇ (play on עָרְפָּה) שהכל עורפין וכ׳ all covered her from behind.

to have the neck broken. Ib. IX, 7 (47ᵃ) נמצא … עד שלא נֶעֶרְפָּה וכ׳ (Y. ed. עד שלא תֵיעָרֵף) if the murderer was discovered before the heifer was put to death; משנִתְעָרְפָה העגלה Mish. (Y. a. Bab. ed. משנערפה) after the ceremony had taken place. Ib. 46ᵃ יבוא דבר … ויֵעָרֵף וכ׳ let there be brought a thing which has not yet produced fruit (a heifer) and be broken in a place which produces no fruit, and atone for the murder of him who was prevented from producing fruit (good deeds on earth).
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42:9">Ex. R. s. 42</cite>, end (play on <he>קשה ערף</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 32:9">Ex. XXXII, 9</cite>) <he>ראויים הם להֵעָרֵף</he> they deserve to have their necks broken; a. e.
